codex.norse.name: Norse Codex
codex.norse.description: The permanent founding Codex of Rune Scribe, presented with weathered stone, forged iron, gold light, and the Base Rune Script.

relics.relic.norse.runestone.weathered: A broad weathered stone tablet held within an iron and gold frame, with a raven crest above the inscription.
relics.relic.norse.raven-medallion: A circular forged medallion with a pale stone inscription face and a raven crest, suited to shorter messages.
relics.relic.norse.ironbound-shield: A round wooden shield reinforced by iron, with a pale circular inscription field at its center.
relics.relic.norse.sealed-parchment: A wide aged parchment with iron fittings and a raven seal, suited to longer messages.
relics.relic.norse.runestone.blackstone: A ceremonial black stone tablet crossed by restrained gold and blue forge-light cracks.
relics.relic.norse.runestone.frozen: A pale blue rune stone edged with frost and ice, with a clear central inscription field.

seals.seal.norse.knotwork: An interlaced gold knot surrounding a small blue center stone.
seals.seal.norse.forge-flame: A gold forge flame with a blue inner flame.
seals.seal.norse.raven: A silver raven in profile on a dark forged medallion.
seals.seal.norse.longship: A longship with two sails above a single blue wave.
seals.seal.norse.forge-hammer: A forged hammer with a small blue spark.
seals.seal.norse.echo-rune: A central rune between expanding gold and blue echo arcs.

frame.frame.norse.carved-knotwork: A carved silver and gold knotwork frame with restrained corner ornaments.

crest.crest.norse.forge-master: A shield-shaped Forge Master crest showing an anvil, blue flame, and paired silver wings.

background.background.norse.forge-v1: A dark navy and midnight-purple field with subdued blue energy bands and small gold rune glows.
background.background.norse.high-contrast: A nearly black static field with bright, simplified gold and blue accents.

policies.decorativeRunicHeadings: Hide the decorative runic heading from VoiceOver when the adjacent localized subtitle already names the destination.
policies.lockedState: Never communicate locked, selected, owned, encountered, or unavailable state by color alone.
policies.reduceMotion: Replace tracing, assembly, particle, and scale animations with short crossfades and static highlights.
policies.dynamicType: User-facing labels, requirements, and security summaries use Dynamic Type. Decorative glyph artwork may scale within bounded safe regions but cannot replace readable labels.
policies.sound: Unlock sounds are optional, respect silent mode and volume, and have an independent Setting.
policies.haptics: Haptics are supplemental only and never the sole indication of completion.
